{"metadata":{"description":"Tavily-backed web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — registers a tavily search provider into ctx.web with a settings card in the web GUI","id":"gh:1334654243","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-tavily","slug":"1624318455/dsh-plugin-tavily","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","tavily","web-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Tavily-backed web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — registers a tavily search prov"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ider into ctx.web with a settings card in the web GUI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-tavily"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A Tavily-backed **web search provider plugin** for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It is the **professional/"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"pro-user edition**: it exposes the full Tavily request parameter set through the web GUI, while stil"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"l letting developers pin values from the profile configuration file."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It registers a `tavily` search provider into the harness's `ctx.web` seam, so the built-in `web_sear"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ch` tool searches the web through Tavily — and ships a **settings card** in the web GUI (`设置 → 插件 → "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"网页搜索`) where you paste your API key, tune advanced parameters, and test connectivity. One install, b"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"e you paste your API key, tune advanced parameters, and test connectivity. One install, both halves."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Install-and-use (no manual config)**: installing this plugin **auto-selects Tavily as the `web_s"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"earch` provider** via its `cordis.patch.yml`. Paste a key in the card and search — no yaml or `DSH_W"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"EB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` edits required.
- **Tavily/DeepSeek engine switch**: a GUI switch answers `web_s"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"earch` with Tavily (default; keyless if no key) or falls back to the **official DeepSeek** provider "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"— no uninstall needed. This is a real provider-switch UI, not a config file edit.
- **Server-side co"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"nnectivity probe**: `POST /api/tavily-probe` lets the card test a **stored** key (browsers cannot re"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ad stored secrets), using keyless mode when none is set.
- **Status indicator**: a `GET /api/tavily-"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"status` route reads the stored key and Tavily `GET /usage` (no search credits) and the card shows a "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"live ✅/⚠️/❌ badge (normal / credits low / API error, or "no key"), refreshed by the host without re-"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"entering the key.
- **Full professional parameter set in the GUI**: API key, API Base URL, `maxResul"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ts`, `searchDepth` (basic/advanced/fast/ultra-fast), `topic`, `includeAnswer`, `includeRawContent`, "},{"id":"p7s12","text":"`timeout`, `days`, `chunksPerSource`, `timeRange`, `startDate`/`endDate`, `includeImages`, `includeD"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"omains`/`excludeDomains`, and `country` are editable from the card; advanced fields are tucked into "},{"id":"p7s14","text":"a collapsed `<details>` block so ordinary users are not overwhelmed.
- **Parameter presets**: one cl"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"ick stages a bundle of advanced values — **Deep research** (advanced depth, more results, raw conten"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"t), **Quick summary** (basic depth, few results, detailed answer), **Live news** (news topic, day wi"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"ndow) — then press Save; yaml-pinned fields are left alone.
- **Configuration-first priority**: `cor"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"dis.patch.yml` > WebUI > code defaults. Any field explicitly set in the yaml is shown disabled on th"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"e card with a "covered by config file" badge, so a stale UI value can never shadow a developer's pin"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"ned config.

Install from npm:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"During development, install from a local path instead:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Or from the repository's main branch (every merged commit):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` already sets `web.config.searchProvider: tavily`, so installing it *"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"*elects Tavily as the search provider for you** — no manual provider selection needed."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Enable"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. **Install & restart dsh.** The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` already sets `web.config.searchProvide"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"r: tavily`, so Tavily is elected automatically — **no manual provider selection needed**."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"2. **Set the Tavily API key** (optional). Open `设置 → 插件 → 网页搜索`, expand the **Web search (Tavily)** "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"card, and paste the key into the **API key** field. Without a key Tavily runs **keyless** (free, rat"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e-limited); with a key it uses your account tier. Choose the **Web search engine** switch: `tavily` "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"(default) or `official DeepSeek`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"3. Use `web_search` as usual. The model-facing tool is unchanged; only the backend answering it is n"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ow Tavily (or DeepSeek, if you switched)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> If you ever override the provider in yaml by hand, this is the row:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Enable the fetch (Extract) provider (optional)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin also registers a Tavily Extract-backed **fetch** provider (`tavily-extract`) for reading "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"a full page's content from a URL. It is inert until selected — set the fetch provider the same way a"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s the search provider:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"or, in `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"To use the optional **Firecrawl** page retriever instead (own key required — default credential refe"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"rence `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`):"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"or `fetchProvider: firecrawl` in the same `cordis.patch.yml` row. Without a Firecrawl key the provid"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"er reports `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` on a fetch and stays inert otherwise."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Verify the backend is really Tavily"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The `web_search` tool's output schema is provider-agnostic — the model never sees a provider name, a"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"nd the API key intentionally lives outside environment variables, so "check the env" is the wrong pr"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"obe. To confirm the active backend:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Provider selection** — `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` has the `web` row with `searchProv"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ider: tavily`.
- **Plugin loaded** — the composed profile tree lists the `web-search-tavily` entry ("},{"id":"p32s3","text":"`dsh --profile web --dump-config`).
- **Credential in place** — `TAVILY_API_KEY` exists in the crede"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ntials store (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`), not in the environment.
- **Result fingerprint** — a Tavi"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"ly result carries a generated-answer summary in `content`; the built-in DeepSeek provider does not p"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"arries a generated-answer summary in `content`; the built-in DeepSeek provider does not produce one."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Troubleshooting: "I still get a DeepSeek API key error""},{"id":"p34s1","text":"This plugin now **auto-selects Tavily** (`web.searchProvider: tavily`), so a fresh install answers `"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"web_search` with Tavily — no such error in normal use. If you still see a DeepSeek key error:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.** The plugin targets the 0.2.x plugin API: the settings form is declare"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"d by marking the plugin's `Config` schema fields `.volatile()`, the card reads its section through `"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ctx.configForms`, and the card registers into the Plugins page's `plugins.item` slot. Older 0.1.x ru"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"ntimes used a different settings contract and are not supported.
- **Tavily API key** — paste it int"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"o the card, or store `TAVILY_API_KEY` in the credentials store."}],"truncated":true}
